c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Require Photo ID for Voting
c.q: Constitutional amendment to require all voters not just those presenting to vote in person to present photo identification before voting.

c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Maximum Income Tax Rate of 3.5%
c.q: Constitutional amendment to keep the State income tax rate from being raised higher than three and one-half percent (3.5%).

c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Property Tax Levy Limit
c.q: Constitutional amendment requiring limits on property tax increases by local governments.

c.t: Guilford County Local Sales and Use Tax Referendum
c.q: Local sales and use tax at the rate of one-fourth of one percent (0.25%) in addition to all other State and local sales and use taxes to be used solely for classroom teacher salary supplements (70%) for fire protection equipment and services (18%) for Guilford Technical Community College (8%) and for qualifying municipalities for allowable expenses (4%).

c.t: City of Greensboro Parks and Recreation Bonds Referendum
c.q: Additional property taxes may be levied on property located in the City of Greensboro North Carolina in an amount sufficient to pay the principal of and interest on bonds if approved by the following ballot question.Shall the order adopted on August 3 2026 authorizing $11500000 PARKS AND RECREATION BONDS of the City of Greensboro North Carolina plus interest for the purpose of providing funds together with any other available funds for acquiring constructing renovating remediating improving and equipping various parks and recreational facilities for said City including without limitation the acquisition of related land rights of way and equipment and the provision of loans grants or other financial assistance to other parties to facilitate such purposes and providing that additional taxes may be levied in an amount sufficient to pay the principal of and interest on said bonds be approved in light of the following:(1) The estimated cumulative cost over the life of said bonds using the highest interest rate charged for similar debt over the last 20 years would be $18257755 consisting of the $11500000 principal amount of said bonds plus $6757755 of estimated interest.(2) The estimated amount of property tax liability increase for each one hundred thousand dollars ($100000) of property tax value to service the cumulative cost over the life of said bonds provided above would be $2.80 per year.

c.q: Additional property taxes may be levied on property located in the City of Greensboro North Carolina in an amount sufficient to pay the principal of and interest on bonds if approved by the following ballot question.Shall the order adopted on August 3 2026 authorizing $5000000 HOUSING BONDS of the City of Greensboro North Carolina plus interest for the purpose of providing funds together with any other available funds for acquiring constructing improving rehabilitating and equipping multifamily and single family housing units in said City principally for the benefit of persons of low and moderate income including without limitation housing or neighborhood revitalization and permanent supportive housing programs and the providing of loans grants or other financial assistance to such persons and to developers and other public and private providers of housing and providing that additional taxes may be levied in an amount sufficient to pay the principal of and interest on said bonds be approved in light of the following:(1) The estimated cumulative cost over the life of said bonds using the highest interest rate charged for similar debt over the last 20 years would be $8063912 consisting of the $5000000 principal amount of said bonds plus $3063912 of estimated interest.(2) The estimated amount of property tax liability increase for each one hundred thousand dollars ($100000) of property tax value to service the cumulative cost over the life of said bonds provided above would be $1.20 per year.
